description: Rep. Suzanne Wikle, a Lawrence Democrat, said her primary issue with the bill was the modification of the appeals process. Democrats initially were left out of the newly established legislative panel but were later included, Wikle said.

title: Kansas lawmakers alter bidding process for Medicaid services after Aetna loses state contract — Suzanne Wikle | Democrat for Lawrence
